items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Alvino Rey, guitarist, he was with Horace Heidt who was the house band at the Golden Gate Theater for many years, and then when that band, Horace Heidt split, why Alvino Rey formed his own band and he came up from Los Angeles. He played the T&D Theater.

ctx.x: You probably have no way of knowing this, but do you think that bands would change their songlist from the white night to the colored night?

That’s a good question. Not going to the white night band, I think they played their recorded hits, whatever their records were. Because with Krupa, he just played everything he played. Well a lot of it had to do with tempo, see the dance tempo. A lot of it was that. And all the bands sounded good. Heck. Vaughn Monroe’s band, they came into the T&D Theater and he had an excellent band. There was a sweet band. Alvino Rey, guitarist, he was with Horace Heidt who was the house band at the Golden Gate Theater for…
Well let me ask you, the first time you made money playing the drums. Do you recall that?
